system.description: Suffer 1 corruption per {Dc}. Then tension resets to zero. Pact with DARK POWERS: If a party member performs a Spell action, other members of the Secret Coven within close range must tribute 1 power to the spell for each active member of this party sheet. On any party member casting, all party members within close range suffer the following effects: Suffer 1 stress per {Dc}. Suffer 1 wound per {Dc}.
